# Pond Boat Rentals

Lake Union Park is home to a model boat pond — 2 feet deep and 100 feet wide — one of only a handful in the country, and open to the public year-round. Any type of boat is welcome except gas-powered hydroplanes. Bring your own model boat or rent one of ours. CWB is proud to help bring the park to life.

Hand-crafted model pond boats are available to rent at the front desk of the Wagner Education Center whenever it is open.

**Cost: $20 for 1-hour rental**
